print_description: Bold, surprising colours bring the picture to life.
Shapes show the same thing from different sides.
Small brushstrokes capture light and a passing moment.
Expressive colours and energetic brushstrokes add feeling.
Twisted shapes and strong colours show big feelings.
Familiar things meet in a strange, dreamlike world.
Straight black lines balance blocks of red, yellow and blue.
Bright colours and repeated images turn daily life into art.
